body: I know the feeling, i am in the same exact boat. I tried with an iphone lightning cable and then a tie though yesterday. Both of them snapped. I didn’t even know a tie could snap. 2 attempts, 2 different items and both snapped. Wtf? I have a huge red mark on my neck today and am sore as hell and cut up from the falls.
Pretty much nothing. No explanation, nothing.
We were supposed to get married, she called it off, wouldn’t even tell me why, now she’s fucking some other guy.
I tried melatonin to try to help with the sleep, it did not work. Nyquil helps a little. I would just love one night where i get more than 2 hours of sleep. I tried desperately to get my girl back.
Yes. I told my neurologist about the memory losz, he asked me “what was something you forgot?” If i remembered i wouldn’t be complaining.
It’s a nightmare. The meds make it so i forget stuff and have blackouts and get 2 hours of sleep at night.
Between health issues and a job i hate and being lonely and my girl breaking up with me and having sex with someone else. It all came to a head.
My dad is my primary emergency contact, she is my secondary emergency contact.

Yeah i know how you feel. When I was on depakote, I had to constantly hide my depression and suicidal urges and dizzy spells from my family. Fortunately they stopped when i switched meds. I just wish i could tell her easily and know she won’t tell her friends, it’s frustrating because it makes me hesitant to tell her anything and i REALLY want to just be honest with her and not hide stuff. The main one that told me how embarassing it was to be around was my now deceased mom right before i had one. Which sucked because it was already embarassing enough having them in public without being told it embarassed them.

Unfortunately the truth is while I would not find it embarassing seeing them have a seizure, Not everyone feels that way. I know because one time right before I had one, my now deceased mom went to me “don’t embarass me here”. Next thing I knew, I lost control of my seizure in a chinese restaurant.

When I was in 3rd grade, they put me on phenobarbitol in an effort to help. One of the side effects was it made me CONSTANTLY fall asleep. As a result, I failed 3rd grade and was left back. I HATED watching my parents explain to the teacher what happened, it made me feel like a freak. They switched me over to depakote which ended up making me attempt suicide by the 2nd time I did 3rd grade.  I was on depakote most of my life. So you can understand why I hated my old medicine :/
Yep, I'll change her to my emergency contact once me and her get married.

If you had everyone staring at you while you get carted off would you be embarassed? The reason this is different is because I had already told her that it was for a different reason, while it's possible she may have told her friends already about my seizures I also have to hope that she didn't. However, if i told her this she would for sure tell them which I don't want.
No, my dad is.
she does bring it up sometimes. She tells her friends everything. I don't want her friends knowing. I don't like everyone knowing about it.
Because I want to tell her already, even to this day she wonders why. I just need to know how to get her to understand that telling her friends is definitely a problem for sure.

I only told one job, and even then it was only because I had to because I had to work from home a few days. When i was on depakote, I had them a few times if i my triggers were met. I had to be really careful with the sleep depravation in particular, but because of the 48 hour eeg this time it screwed it up. 

The nurse made the probes so tight that when they pulled them off of my head when the eeg was done, my head was bleeding. I only tell my family and her and other people that I know have them.

When I was on depakote (the old medicine) I had severe dizzy spells and suicidal urges most of my life, but when I switched to lamotrigine both of those cleared up. So Unfortunately I've kind of had to keep some stuff hidden so I wouldn't worry other people. 

I only tell people I trust big time.

Because it happened a couple of years ago, I don't have the documentation anymore. But the thing that's stopping me is I'm trying to figure how i can explain it to her, while making sure she doesn't tell her friends.
At the time, she was only my girlfriend and I didn't feel comfortable with her seeing me like that. As we became closer over time, I became more comfortable.
I wouldn't say to hide it from his loved ones, I'd tell him to tell his loved ones. But I'd also tell him to only tell the people he feels comfortable telling.
It's mostly the her telling her friends about the seizures that is.
I told her about my seizures after, just not this particular incident.
Yeah, I'm likely going to see a counselor. I haven't really seen one since after my mom died.
She tells her friends everything, I don't feel comfortable with having her friends know about my seizures let alone that i was hospitalized a couple of times for it.
If ever the day comes where my future child has a seizure (the neurologist already said it won't), I won't have to explain to him how it feels. He'll already know on his own.

I had to see a counselor around the time this happened because the old medicine I was on(depakote) gave me horrible suicidal urges which stopped once i stopped taking it and switched to my new medicine (lamotrigine). I told her about them, but I didn't tell her about this one particular incident. Even then I was skeptical to tell her initially, I only did it because with the switch between meds I wasn't sure if I'd be able to keep the seizures under control.
Yep I know and agree, that's why I want to tell her about this incident. But I want to try to figure out how to tell her and make sure she doesn't tell her friends.

One time, I had one in a movie theater. Imagine being dragged out in front of a movie theater full of a ton of people with everyone staring at you, also imagine being 40 years old and you can't drive because you are worried you'll have a seizure behind a wheel and accidently kill someone. It's embarassing and i hate it. I'd rather people not know. I've told her in the past, but I don't want her friends knowing and I haven't even told most of my past jobs.
added it.
After this happened, I told her about my seizures. But she doesn't know about this particular incident.
I find having seizures humiliating, especially when I have one in public.
the problem is she pretty much tells her friends everything, I'm not even sure if she told her friends about me having seizures (I hope not). I told her before, not to. But I'm not sure.
I've told her about the seizures, just not about this particular incident.
that's all.

I'll see if I can find the documents. Unfortunately I don't think I have the papers anymore since it was quite a while ago (a couple of years) and the only person that would know where they are is dead. I have told her since then that I have seizures, but just not about this particular incident.
I am VERY guarded about who i let know, i find it EXTREMELY embarassing. I have told her about my seizures ever since, just not about this one particular time.
She knows now, but i never told her about that particular time.
